summary_md: **杨飞飞 ([@H359kkk](https://x.com/H359kkk/status/2115336818916778317))** describes **OpenBot**, a local-first desktop workspace for persistent AI teammates: it drives Codex App Server and Claude Code, plus Grok CLI, OpenCode, Gemini, Cursor CLI and Cline CLI through ACP, giving each agent its own workspace and conversation with local queues, file transfer, an embedded browser and agent-to-agent messaging.
